about.headline:
WE ARE
CREATIVEFX.
about.body: A team of passionate creatives, storytellers, and technologists dedicated to crafting unforgettable visual experiences. We believe every brand has a unique story — our mission is to tell it beautifully.
about.lead: CreativeFX is a creative agency focused on turning ideas into meaningful visual experiences.
about.body1: We believe great content is more than beautiful visuals. It is about having the right idea, telling the right story, and making people feel something.
about.body2: From businesses looking to build their online presence to individuals capturing important milestones, we bring creativity and professional production together to create content that stands out.
about.vision: To become a leading creative design studio recognized for innovation, creativity, and impactful visual experiences that inspire brands and audiences.
about.mission: To deliver high quality creative solutions that help businesses communicate their ideas effectively through design, digital media, and visual storytelling while maintaining professionalism, creativity, and client satisfaction.

projects.title: PRODUCTS
projects.summary: High-end product videography featuring intricate macro shots, dynamic lighting, and cinematic motion.
projects.challenge: Capturing the essence and detail of physical products while maintaining brand identity.
projects.solution: Utilized precision robotic arms, custom lighting setups, and advanced color grading.

projects.title: MARKETING
projects.summary: Engaging marketing campaigns designed to captivate audiences and drive brand awareness.
projects.challenge: Creating scroll-stopping content in a saturated digital landscape.
projects.solution: Fast-paced editing, bold typography, and energetic sound design.

projects.title: GRADUATION
projects.summary: Cinematic graduation films capturing the proudest moments and the journey of achievement.
projects.challenge: Documenting the emotion and scale of convocation ceremonies.
projects.solution: Multi-camera setups and intimate portrait sessions mixed with event coverage.

projects.title: EVENTS
projects.summary: Dynamic event coverage that encapsulates the energy, scale, and atmosphere of live experiences.
projects.challenge: Adapting to unpredictable lighting and fast-paced environments.
projects.solution: Run-and-gun cinematography with stabilized rigs and low-light capable lenses.

projects.title: BIRTHDAY FILMS
projects.summary: Joyful and cinematic birthday films that preserve beautiful memories with family and friends.
projects.challenge: Capturing candid emotions without interrupting the celebration.
projects.solution: Unobtrusive shooting style with a focus on genuine interactions and atmospheric details.

projects.title: DIVYA & ROHAN
projects.summary: A cinematic wedding film blending architectural heritage with contemporary romance.
projects.challenge: Capturing multiple days of celebration while maintaining a cohesive, documentary-style narrative flow.
projects.solution: Utilized discrete cinema rigs and natural lighting to preserve the authenticity of every moment.

projects.title: ZOVA CLOTHING
projects.summary: High-end fashion photography showcasing the latest collection with striking poses and moody lighting.
projects.challenge: Highlighting fabric textures while maintaining an editorial vibe.
projects.solution: Used specialized strobe lighting and a neutral background.

projects.title: CEYLON GEMS
projects.summary: Macro product photography capturing the brilliance, cut, and clarity of premium gemstones.
projects.challenge: Managing reflections and highlighting the internal facets of the gems.
projects.solution: Focus stacking and polarized lighting techniques.

projects.title: 25TH ANNIVERSARY
projects.summary: Capturing the beautiful milestone of a 25th anniversary celebration.
projects.challenge: Documenting candid moments in a dimly lit banquet hall.
projects.solution: Fast prime lenses and discreet off-camera flashes.

projects.title: GENDER REVEAL
projects.summary: A joyous gender reveal party filled with emotion and surprise.
projects.challenge: Capturing the exact split-second of the reveal reaction.
projects.solution: High-speed continuous shooting mode and multiple angles.

projects.title: JANA'S BIRTHDAY
projects.summary: A beautiful birthday portrait session capturing joy and personality.
projects.challenge: Creating a relaxed and fun atmosphere for the subject.
projects.solution: Used natural daylight and interactive prompts.

projects.title: THATHSARANI
projects.summary: Stunning outdoor birthday portraits focusing on natural beauty.
projects.challenge: Balancing harsh sunlight during the outdoor shoot.
projects.solution: Used diffusers and shot during the golden hour.

projects.title: GRADUATION FILMS
projects.summary: Cinematic graduation films that preserve one of life's most cherished milestones with emotional depth and visual beauty.
projects.challenge: Capturing raw emotion across a large venue with hundreds of graduates while maintaining storytelling cohesion.
projects.solution: Multi-camera coverage with handheld cinema rigs and telephoto lenses for intimate close-ups.

projects.title: CASUAL SHOOT
projects.summary: Relaxed, candid portrait sessions that bring out natural personality and genuine emotion.
projects.challenge: Creating comfortable, authentic moments without the stiffness of a traditional studio shoot.
projects.solution: Shot in natural environments with lifestyle prompts and minimal direction.

projects.title: RAVINDU & MALIKSHI
projects.summary: A beautiful wedding story told through intimate photography — from the pre-dawn preparations to the final dance.
projects.challenge: Balancing grand ceremony scale with intimate, emotional micro-moments throughout the day.
projects.solution: Two-photographer approach with prime lenses for low-light ceremony coverage and wide angles for grand venue shots.

projects.title: EVENTS & CELEBRATIONS
projects.summary: High-energy event films for corporate celebrations, private parties, and milestone events across Sri Lanka.
projects.challenge: Maintaining narrative structure and visual consistency across unpredictable, dynamic events.
projects.solution: Pre-event planning sessions with clients and multi-camera setups with dedicated audio capture.

projects.title: DANCE COVERS
projects.summary: Energetic and rhythmic dance cover video productions with dynamic lighting and camera movement.
projects.challenge: Synchronizing camera movement and edits with complex choreography and rhythm.
projects.solution: Custom gimbal moves, speed ramping, and beat-matched cuts.

projects.title: RAVINDU & MALIKSHI PRE-SHOOT
projects.summary: An intimate pre-wedding shoot ahead of the big day — relaxed moments, chemistry and anticipation.
projects.challenge: Helping a couple feel natural on camera before their wedding day.
projects.solution: A pressure-free location session that doubles as a comfort-building experience.

projects.title: GRADUATION PHOTOGRAPHY
projects.summary: Convocation and graduation portrait sessions — robes, diplomas and proud smiles captured across IIT, Sabaragamuwa, Peradeniya and private sittings.
projects.challenge: Compressing individual portraits and ceremony energy into fast-moving schedules across venues.
projects.solution: Dedicated portrait stations paired with roaming candid coverage and scouted campus backdrops.

weddingStories.storyQuote: Not a single moment felt forced or uncomfortable. CreativeFX captured the true emotions, the laughter, and every tear so beautifully.
storyParagraphs: Set against the historic oceanfront backdrop of Colombo, Ravindu and Malikshi wanted their wedding documented authentically—focusing on genuine emotions rather than stiff poses.
Our team covered every chapter of their special day with multi-camera 4K cinema coverage and high-resolution photography, preserving the colors, the joy, and the intimate memories for a lifetime.

weddingApproach.desc: We craft rich, true-to-life tones that never go out of style. Years from now, your photos will look just as stunning and vibrant as they felt on your wedding day.

weddingApproach.title: ALL-DAY DEDICATED TEAM
